sara (support): FYI customer SUP-8721 reporting decrypts failing after last night's scheduled KMS rotation. Got a stack trace and CloudTrail IDs, looks like AccessDenied on decrypt.
kevin (infra): Can you paste the error?
sara (support): `An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Decrypt operation: Access denied`
kevin (infra): thx. Which key/alias?
sara (support): alias/redwood/customer-tenant-42, region us-west-2. CloudTrail eventId: 0abcd-1234-efgh-5678.
kevin (infra): @mike @elena can we check grants/alias pointer? Suspect alias pointed to new CMK without grant for the service account.
mike (secuops): I pulled the CloudTrail entry — decrypt requests are arriving with an encryptionContext that includes `tenant_id=42` and `flow=ingest`. The new CMK has a key policy that looks right but no explicit grant for the service-role ARN.
elena (sre): Repro steps from support: 1) POST /v1/generate with tenant 42, 2) SDK does local envelope decrypt call to KMS, 3) sees AccessDenied. Repro on staging with same alias -> same error.
sara (support): customer also complained about increased 95p latency around the rotation window. Might be retries.
kevin (infra): commands to inspect (run from ops host with relevant creds):
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood/customer-tenant-42
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood/customer-tenant-42
```
mike (secuops): I ran `list-grants` and indeed there are zero grants for the new key. Old key (pre-rotation) had a grant for `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-service-role`. That explains AccessDenied on Decrypt for the envelope key flow.
elena (sre): Noted. Why didn't the rotation process re-create grants? The automation should replicate grants to the new CMK.
kevin (infra): Looks like our rotation playbook had a step gated by `--preserve-grants` flag but the automation run used a dry-run mode then switched keys and skipped grants due to race. Filing followup.
sara (support): Customer wants immediate workaround — what can we do to re-enable decrypts?
mike (secuops): Short-term: add a grant for the service-role to the new key. Command:
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/redwood/customer-tenant-42 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-service-role \
  --operations Encrypt Decrypt ReEncryptFrom ReEncryptTo GenerateDataKey
```
elena (sre): We'll need to ensure encryptionContext matches. If the SDK sends `encryptionContext={"tenant_id":"42","flow":"ingest"}` we must allow decrypts only when context matches. If we create a grant without context restriction it will work but reduces scoping. Any objections?
kevin (infra): For incident mitigation, allow broader grant to restore service. We'll then rotate/update automation to reapply scoped grants ASAP.
sara (support): Customer approved the mitigation (they're down). Please proceed and ping when fixed.
mike (secuops): Done — created grant, verified decrypts succeed for tenant 42. Customer confirmed traffic normalizing and latency returning to baseline. :white_check_mark:
kevin (infra): Next steps: (1) run audit across all recently rotated keys to ensure grants exist, (2) patch rotation automation to copy grants, (3) add a pre-cutover check that validates `list-grants` output, (4) add an incident playbook note.
mike (secuops): I'll open INC-2384 for the automation bug and link SUP-8721.
jira-bot: INC-2384 created and linked to SUP-8721. Assignee: kevin (infra).
kevin (infra): I'll roll out the patch to rotation-runner and add a Canary test that rotates a test key and verifies `aws kms list-grants` shows previous grants.
elena (sre): Also adding a dashboard alert for 403 decrypt rate > 0.5% for >5m.
sara (support): Adding notes to SUP-8721 with timeline, mitigation, and suggested customer steps.
mike (secuops): After patch I'll run a one-off audit script:
```
for key in $(cat recent_rotations.txt); do
  grants=$(aws kms list-grants --key-id $key)
  if [[ $grants == "" ]]; then
    echo "MISSING_GRANTS $key"
  fi
done
```
kevin (infra): Good. Also check CloudHSM portal for any HSM-backed key anomalies; nothing looks red now but worth checking.
sara (support): Customer updated: "Thanks, decrypts working. Please keep us posted on root cause." I'll close SUP-8721 once postmortem is published.
mike (secuops): Will write up short postmortem and link the rotation playbook: https://redwood.internal/kms/rotation-playbook.
kevin (infra): Ping @oncall for final postmortem review.
ms (kms-bot): rotation-runner job #9876: completed at 2026-03-16T03:45:00Z (dry-run=false, preserve-grants=false) — automation log available.
kevin (infra): OK that's the log that shows the missing flag. We'll fix and backfill grants.
elena (sre): Closing thread, tracking in INC-2384.
